steps.name: DESeq2 Wald test on condition:time interaction
caveats: With three replicates per cell the interaction coefficient is a difference of two differences with a larger standard error than a main effect at the same replicate number; the interaction test has low power. Keep the interaction as the primary result, report simple effects beside it, state the power limit, and do not loosen the threshold to compensate (R-0063@6190).

At three replicates per group the count model finds a minority of the true DE genes, most with large fold changes; a gene absent from the interaction list is not shown to have the same effect at both times (R-0017@8a47).

Counts are already gene-level integers from Salmon, so tximport length-scaled import (R-0018@a472) is not applicable to this matrix; record that differential transcript usage cannot be assessed and that length offsets could not be carried.
With cells of 3 replicates (< 7), DESeq2 flags count outliers by Cook's distance and sets those p-values to NA instead of replacing counts; report the flagged-gene count (R-0039@e17a).

plan.title: Condition × time interaction DE in 2x2 cell-line RNA-seq
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question is whether the treatment (condition) effect on gene expression differs between the two time points (t0, t1) — a condition:time interaction — in 12 human cell-line samples (2 conditions x 2 times x 3 replicates, single batch), with a 12000-gene x 12-sample raw integer gene-level count matrix from Salmon and a 12x4 metadata table (condition, time, time_hours). The procedure of record for an interaction question with counts is DESeq2 with the two factors and their interaction term: test the interaction coefficient with the Wald test, then report the simple condition effect at each time beside it, because an interaction coefficient alone does not say whether a condition effect exists at either level. With three replicates per cell the interaction term is a difference of differences with a large standard error, so the plan keeps alpha at 0.05, states the expected power limit in the report, and does not loosen thresholds to compensate. Flow: (T1S1) sample structure QC on blind variance-stabilized counts to confirm the 2x2 grouping and flag outliers before any test; (T1S2) minimal pre-filter, median-of-ratios size factors, ~ condition + time + condition:time model, Wald test on the interaction coefficient, ashr-shrunken fold changes, BH at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering and a p-value histogram diagnostic; (T1S3) report with the three per-gene effects side by side (simple effect at reference time, simple effect at other time, interaction contrast), MA and dispersion fit diagnostics, and the power statement. A second-method (edgeR QL) robustness overlap was considered but the method check for this situation permits DESeq2 Wald only, so the report states results from the single permitted model. Note on inputs: counts are already summarized to gene level, so no tximport length-scaled import is possible from this matrix; this is recorded as a limitation (differential transcript usage cannot be assessed from a gene-level matrix).

steps.method: vst blind PCA and sample distance QC
DESeq2 Wald test on condition:time interaction with ashr shrinkage
edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the interaction coefficient (robustness check)
interaction report with simple effects, fit diagnostics, power statement
